component.name: Safeer OS
component.summary: Your computer in your hands - programs, files and devices on top of Linux

description.p: Safeer OS is a full-screen shell over your existing Linux desktop: programs, files, devices, network, sound and settings in one place, made for a TV-like experience with the keyboard, the mouse or the remote of a Safeer device. Linux Mint stays underneath - one click returns you to the desktop.

ul.li: Safeer Link: apps of your phone, tablet and TV, your computer's sound on them, files across devices - at home, no cloud, no account.
Connect a phone without any Safeer app: scan the code and it opens a small page served by your own Safeer Link.
Name your devices; the name is kept by Safeer Link and shown the same everywhere.
Shield: DNS filtering of ads, trackers and dangerous domains for the whole computer.
Includes Safeer Control (Safeer Link for the computer) in the AppImage and Flatpak bundles.

description.p: Safeer from power-on: with Safeer Cinnamon 1.1.0 the boot screen and the login screen can wear the Safeer look too. One switch in Settings (it asks for the administrator password); turning it off restores exactly what was there before.

Keep: a film on the shelf On your devices that you mark with the bookmark no longer expires after 48 hours. Subtitles from the torrent also arrive when another device streams the film to this computer. Your sources in the Media Centre (add-ons, podcasts, playlists, streams) are now the same on the computer and on your Android devices in Safeer Link; an add-on that marks itself as private stays on the device where you added it. Apps on the desktop: the programs of this computer are listed too, every tile has a star and Favourites is always the first tab.

The shelf On your devices in the Media Centre: films that any device in your Safeer Link has downloaded from a torrent - computer, phone, tablet or TV - with title and poster; the device that keeps the film plays it. A film you watched in Safeer OS on the computer is offered to your other devices too. Titles from a private add-on stay on the computer without title or poster and never appear on the shelf.

Packaged with Safeer Control 2.1.29: a film the computer downloads for your TV, tablet or phone is now remembered with its title and poster, so it appears on the shelf On your devices on all your devices. No changes to Safeer OS itself.

Films that add-ons offer as torrents now play in the Media Centre on the computer: the computer downloads the film and the player starts while it is still downloading. Asking again for a film that is already downloading no longer waits, Safeer OS and Safeer Control can use torrents at the same time, and a film also starts on a slow disk.

Packaged with Safeer Control 2.1.27: films the computer fetched for your TV, tablet or phone are removed automatically once nobody has played them for 48 hours, and Safeer Control no longer slowly accumulates background threads. No changes to Safeer OS itself.

Media Center: the same catalogue as on your other devices - films, series, music, radio and live TV with genres and search, Stremio add-ons and media servers, playlists from YouTube and Spotify. Playlists stay the same on all devices in your Safeer Link.
Web start page: remove any shortcut (built-in ones too) and restore the defaults; update offered from the Safeer Control tray menu.
Updates: Safeer Control offers the update from its tray menu too; the home banner jumps straight to the Updates button; an AppImage is replaced in place.
Updates: the Settings section also tells what is new in the offered version.
Updates: Safeer OS checks safeer.si itself, shows a note on the home screen and installs a new version from Settings with one press (DEB via pkexec, Flatpak, AppImage).

"Playback for other devices" switch next to "Trust this computer" in Safeer Link; "Continue from another device" also as a button in the Media Centre header; the sender is told when the target cannot show a notification (Safeer Control 2.1.20).

Continue from another device on the computer (a card in the Media Centre asks your Link devices what they play or last watched) and Send to device from the player on the computer; the sender is told when the target has notifications switched off (Safeer Control 2.1.19).
Send to device: a phone or TV can send what it is playing to this computer; a quiet Accept/Decline banner appears and Safeer OS continues at the same second only after Accept (Safeer Control 2.1.18).

Continue on another device: your phone or TV can ask what Safeer OS is playing on this computer and continue at the same second (files from shared folders only; Safeer Control 2.1.17). safeer-os --predvajaj opens a file in the player.
The trust circle tidies itself: a device unseen for 90 days is removed from the circle on all devices; sibling identities of live devices stay.
Safeer Control sends Stremio request headers along when it transcodes a stream for a device; a D-Bus call for any Safeer Link command (diagnostics).
The computer now helps devices that cannot play a video: Safeer Control converts it on the fly (VAAPI or CPU) and streams it to them over Safeer Link.

Convert a whole folder for TV: every video gets its own device in Safeer Link, so several devices work at once and the folder is done sooner. The computer streams torrents to devices even while it is busy with other work.

Convert for TV: right click a video in Files and the device in Safeer Link with the best hardware encoder converts it to H.264 up to 1080p, a format every TV plays. The original stays unchanged; you choose whether to copy the converted video next to it or leave it on the device.

Shared space in Safeer Link: when the computer runs low on disk space, Files shows the largest files and can store one on the device in Safeer Link with the most free space. The copy is verified; you see on which device and in which folder it is, and only then decide whether to delete the original.

The Safeer Link window shows every device's spare capacity and whether it can help. A film that is already fully downloaded on the computer is streamed straight from disk to the TV instead of being downloaded again.

Every device in Safeer Link now reports its spare capacity and whether it can help others right now. The computer helps only when it is not busy, has memory and disk space, and – on a laptop – is plugged in or has at least 40 % battery (it stops below 30 %).

Solidarity in Safeer Link: when a weaker device such as a TV opens a torrent from a Stremio add-on, this computer downloads it and streams it to the TV, so nothing is stored on the TV. The computer only takes on the job when it has spare capacity and disk space, and finished downloads can be removed from the TV's media center.

Pairing a new device with the 6-digit code now works on a computer that hosts its own Safeer Link: the code and a QR code with the home network address appear in Connect devices, and the code closes with the window. Files can create a new folder or file (text, document, spreadsheet, presentation or a template) with a right click, rename and move to Trash. New optional Safeer Cinnamon look for Linux Mint with a desktop workspace.

The side bar can be hidden completely and brought back with a handle on the left edge or Ctrl+B. A device removed from your circle of trust loses access to shared files at once, and the local relay port accepts only your own user account.

Magnet links: choose files, watch while downloading and send to your other devices; links from websites or other apps connect only after you press Open, and files that could be programs are marked. Subtitles like in VLC: found next to the video, in a Subs folder, in a torrent or on other devices, fixed automatically, with language choice and an off switch. Unprotected DVDs from an ISO image, a VIDEO_TS folder or the drive; copy-protected discs are not played. Music and video from your other devices play right away, encrypted, also over Global Link.

Safeer Media: your own library of music, videos and photos from your folders (files stay where they are), albums with next and previous, background music, a built-in video player with full screen and resume, a photo gallery, and TV and radio streams with clear error messages. Safeer Link without a single hub: every device connects directly to the others, and a third device passes messages on when two cannot reach each other. Sound to network speakers (DLNA), the web with tabs, and a collapsible side bar.
New Messages section: email (IMAP/SMTP) and Chatwoot in one list with one conversation per person, and Safeer Chat between your own devices in Safeer Link – delivered later if a device is offline.

New side bar (Home, Media center, Safeer Link, Programs, Files, Web, Notes, Settings), smart search that opens web, files, programs or media in the right section, notes, the web inside Safeer OS, program icons from all devices, and games from another computer shown full screen. Safeer OS opens in a window; the new safeer-os-tema package makes it your desktop on Linux Mint.

The Shield never blocks system and Safeer updates and only accepts block lists from the server that was asked; lists are written safely to disk. Includes Safeer Control 2.1.1: the TV remote controls media players on the separate TV screen.

Fix: no more crash when listing open windows; the Linux Mint panel is always restored after an abnormal end and Safeer OS starts in safe mode after repeated crashes. The bar and the desktop follow a change of screen (laptop lid closed with a TV attached).

First packaged release of Safeer OS for Linux (.deb, AppImage, Flatpak): programs, files, devices, network, sound, Shield; Safeer Link Web for phones without Safeer; device names shared by all devices; sign-in of the computer with a QR code, no cloud.
